reason: Bridge -> Needs, motivation overtaken: need.ee9f8c2de87c7379's stated motivation is that a self-framed account 'forecloses a third-party reconstruction written without the lab's redactions'. That reconstruction now exists - validation.b50ed7e2b621fe49 (2026-07-29) records Hugging Face publishing a stage-by-stage technical timeline of roughly 17,600 attacker actions, and validation.82c688188575705e (08-01) adds Tailscale's own reconstruction of the same intrusion. The thing the need was written to prevent has already happened, so the motivation is false as written and should be reframed to what a lab-authored account still buys once third parties have published. The same bridges bear on the sibling need.ea09ee71e042e61f (reconstruct traces from sandbox logs), whose value proposition shifts the same way; and need.b1bd5f16248cd651 is pinned to a framework whose stated August 1 finalization passed this week with no recorded outcome.
